title: The Top Salesperson in the New Era
synopsis: A day in the life of China’s top salesperson, Li Jiaqi.

fullText.simplified:
新时代的顶尖销售员

    说起销售员的一天，很多人都觉得是这样的：早上去公司上班，晚上下班回家。而中国却有一位销售员的一天是这样的：下午三点起床；四点到七点之间选择要销售的商品；晚上八点到十二点进行网络直播，把自己选出来的商品卖出去；晚上十二点到第二天早上六点开会，总结当天的情况，并选择第二天要直播卖掉的商品；早上六点到十点是与家人在一起的时间。看到这样的时间表，你有什么感觉呢？
    这是中国最有名的带货主播——李佳琦的一天。他的努力也得到了不错的回报：年收入几个亿。可以说，他是新时代最厉害的销售员了。
    他的出现，是直播带货行业发展的结果。对于消费者来说，有一个帅哥美女给你介绍最便宜好用的商品，是个省心又快乐的购物方式。从2020年开始，中国直播带货行业发展得非常快，最有名的前二十名主播年销售额总计上千亿，开始尝试在直播间购物的消费者也在快速增加。
    因此，很多人选择去做带货主播，但是机会并没有那么多。大部分带货主播都赚不到钱，因为消费者更愿意相信有名的主播；同时品牌商也不愿意给这些小主播更低的价格，因为大主播粉丝多，价格低一点也可以让品牌商赚到钱。
    总的来说，直播带货是一个快速发展的行业，留给普通主播的时间并不多。而已经出名赚大钱的主播们，到底是因为个人能力强还是遇到了好机会，是一个很有意思的问题。
fullText.traditional:
新時代的頂尖銷售員

    說起銷售員的一天，很多人都覺得是這樣的：早上去公司上班，晚上下班回家。而中國卻有一位銷售員的一天是這樣的：下午三點起床；四點到七點之間選擇要銷售的商品；晚上八點到十二點進行網絡直播，把自己選出來的商品賣出去；晚上十二點到第二天早上六點開會，總結當天的情況，並選擇第二天要直播賣掉的商品；早上六點到十點是與家人在一起的時間。看到這樣的時間表，你有什麼感覺呢？
    這是中國最有名的帶貨主播——李佳琦的一天。他的努力也得到了不錯的回報：年收入幾個億。可以說，他是新時代最厲害的銷售員了。
    他的出現，是直播帶貨行業發展的結果。對於消費者來說，有一個帥哥美女給你介紹最便宜好用的商品，是個省心又快樂的購物方式。從2020年開始，中國直播帶貨行業發展得非常快，最有名的前二十名主播年銷售額總計上千億，開始嘗試在直播間購物的消費者也在快速增加。
    因此，很多人選擇去做帶貨主播，但是機會並沒有那麼多。大部分帶貨主播都賺不到錢，因為消費者更願意相信有名的主播；同時品牌商也不願意給這些小主播更低的價格，因為大主播粉絲多，價格低一點也可以讓品牌商賺到錢。
    總的來說，直播帶貨是一個快速發展的行業，留給普通主播的時間並不多。而已經出名賺大錢的主播們，到底是因為個人能力強還是遇到了好機會，是一個很有意思的問題。

sentences.traditional: 可以說，他是新時代最厲害的銷售員了。
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ shuō tā shì xīn shí dài zuì lì hai de xiāo shòu yuán le
sentences.english: His efforts have also paid off: an annual income of several hundred million RMB.
We can say that he is the most formidable salesperson in the new era.

sentences.simplified: 他的出现，是直播带货行业发展的结果。
sentences.traditional: 他的出現，是直播帶貨行業發展的結果。

sentences.traditional: 對於消費者來說，有一個帥哥美女給你介紹最便宜好用的商品，是個省心又快樂的購物方式。
sentences.pinyin: duì yú xiāo fèi zhě lái shuō yǒu yí ge shuài gē měi nǚ gěi nǐ jiè shào zuì pián yi hǎo yòng de shāng pǐn shì ge shěng xīn yòu kuài lè de gòu wù fāng shì
sentences.english: His emergence is the result of the development of the livestream marketing business.

sentences.simplified: 从2020年开始，中国直播带货行业发展得非常快，

sentences.english: For consumers, having a handsome guy or cute girl recommend the cheapest and best products is a worry-free and enjoyable way to shop.

sentences.simplified: 最有名的前二十名主播年销售额总计上千亿，
sentences.traditional: 最有名的前二十名主播年銷售額總計上千億，
sentences.pinyin: zuì yǒu míng de qián èr shí míng zhǔ bō nián xiāo shòu é zǒng jì shàng qiān yì
sentences.english: Since 2020, the livestream marketing business in China has developed extremely quickly.

sentences.simplified: 开始尝试在直播间购物的消费者也在快速增加。
sentences.traditional: 開始嘗試在直播間購物的消費者也在快速增加。

.. and the number of consumers who have tried livestream shopping is also rapidly increasing.

sentences.simplified: 因此，很多人选择去做带货主播，但是机会并没有那么多。
sentences.traditional: 因此，很多人選擇去做帶貨主播，但是機會並沒有那麼多。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ hěn duō rén xuǎn zé qù zuò dài huò zhǔ bō dàn shì jī huì bìng méi yǒu nà me duō

sentences.simplified: 大部分带货主播都赚不到钱，因为消费者更愿意相信有名的主播；
sentences.traditional: 大部分帶貨主播都賺不到錢，因為消費者更願意相信有名的主播；
sentences.pinyin: dà bù fen dài huò zhǔ bō dōu zhuàn bú dào qián yīn wèi xiāo fèi zhě gèng yuàn yì xiāng xìn yǒu míng de zhǔ bō
sentences.english: As a result, lots of people decide to do livestream marketing, but opportunities are not so plentiful.

sentences.simplified: 同时品牌商也不愿意给这些小主播更低的价格，
sentences.traditional: 同時品牌商也不願意給這些小主播更低的價格，
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí pǐn pái shāng yě bú yuàn yì gěi zhè xiē xiǎo zhǔ bō gèng dī de jià gé
sentences.english: Most product livestreamers don’t make any money, because consumers prefer to trust famous livestreamers.

sentences.simplified: 因为大主播粉丝多，价格低一点也可以让品牌商赚到钱。
sentences.traditional: 因為大主播粉絲多，價格低一點也可以讓品牌商賺到錢。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi dà zhǔ bō fěn sī duō jià gé dī yì diǎn yě kě yǐ ràng pǐn pái shāng zhuàn dào qián
sentences.english: At the same time, brands aren’t willing to offer lower prices to small livestreamers, ..
.. because big livestreamers have more fans, so even if prices are lower, the brand can still make money.

sentences.simplified: 总的来说，直播带货是一个快速发展的行业，留给普通主播的时间并不多。
sentences.traditional: 總的來說，直播帶貨是一個快速發展的行業，留給普通主播的時間並不多。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng de lái shuō zhí bō dài huò shì yí ge kuài sù fā zhǎn de háng yè liú gěi pǔ tōng zhǔ bō de shí jiān bìng bù duō

sentences.simplified: 而已经出名赚大钱的主播们，
sentences.traditional: 而已經出名賺大錢的主播們，
sentences.pinyin: ér yǐ jīng chū míng zhuàn dà qián de zhǔ bō men
sentences.english: All in all, livestream marketing is a rapidly developing business, and there isn’t much time left for regular livestreamers.

sentences.simplified: 到底是因为个人能力强还是遇到了好机会，是一个很有意思的问题。
sentences.traditional: 到底是因為個人能力強還是遇到了好機會，是一個很有意思的問題。
sentences.pinyin: dào dǐ shì yīn wèi gè rén néng lì qiáng hái shi yù dào le hǎo jī huì shì yí ge hěn yǒu yì si de wèn tí
sentences.english: As for the already famous livestreamers who are making big money, ..

sentence_translations: The Top Salesperson in the New Era
When it comes to a salesperson’s day, many people think it looks like this:
Go to work in the office in the morning, then at night get off work and go home.
But in China there is a salesperson whose day looks like this:
Get out of bed at 3 pm, choose the products to promote between 4 pm and 7 pm, ..
.. livestream online between 8 pm and midnight to sell the chosen products, ..
.. have a meeting between midnight and 6 am the next day to review the day’s performance and select items to sell the next day, ..
.. and spend time with the family between 6 am and 10 am.
Seeing this kind of schedule, how do you feel?
This is the day of China’s most famous livestream salesperson, Li Jiaqi.
His efforts have also paid off: an annual income of several hundred million RMB.
We can say that he is the most formidable salesperson in the new era.
His emergence is the result of the development of the livestream marketing business.
For consumers, having a handsome guy or cute girl recommend the cheapest and best products is a worry-free and enjoyable way to shop.
Since 2020, the livestream marketing business in China has developed extremely quickly.
The total annual sales of the top 20 most famous livestreamers exceeds 100 billion RMB, ..
.. and the number of consumers who have tried livestream shopping is also rapidly increasing.
As a result, lots of people decide to do livestream marketing, but opportunities are not so plentiful.
Most product livestreamers don’t make any money, because consumers prefer to trust famous livestreamers.
At the same time, brands aren’t willing to offer lower prices to small livestreamers, ..
.. because big livestreamers have more fans, so even if prices are lower, the brand can still make money.
All in all, livestream marketing is a rapidly developing business, and there isn’t much time left for regular livestreamers.
As for the already famous livestreamers who are making big money, ..
.. whether they made it from their own ability or because they came across a good opportunity is an interesting question.
